integrity: Proof is self-contained; exact identities and supplemental samples are reproduced with verify.py. No external or independent certification asserted.
scientific_limitations: Complete for degree-two and all two-focus Cassini oval separations, not for arbitrary higher degrees. The n=2 antipodal model value already appeared in a published note; the new content is the full separation-dependent inradius, all inball centers, and resulting universal quadratic infimum. Older geometric literature may use equivalent terminology; one relevant 2024 paper was inaccessible in full.
title: Exact incircles of all Cassini lemniscates and the quadratic extremal radius
